# ELC

> Accredited English language courses in Saudi Arabia for kids, adults, and businesses.

ELC (English Language Center) offers TVTC-accredited English courses across all
CEFR levels (A1–C2), including Kids General English, Adults General English,
Business English, University/Exam Prep, and Special Courses. Content on this
site is written natively in both English and Arabic, not machine-translated.

## Key pages

- [Courses](https://elc.com.sa/en/courses): Full course catalog with pricing, duration, and level.
- [About](https://elc.com.sa/en/about): Accreditation, facilities, and instructor credentials.
- [About & Why ELC](https://elc.com.sa/en/about): ELC's story, accreditation, teaching approach, learning environment, and quality standards.
- [Register](https://elc.com.sa/en/register): Enrollment and placement testing.
